corpus.title: Refund policy
corpus.content: Customers may return purchased goods within thirty days and receive a full reimbursement to the original payment method. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.

corpus.title: Password recovery
corpus.content: If credentials are forgotten, request a reset link by email. The link expires after one hour and lets you choose new sign-in secrets for the account.

corpus.title: Shipping and delivery
corpus.content: Purchases leave the warehouse within two business days. Delivery estimates appear at checkout, and tracking numbers are sent by email once the parcel ships.

corpus.title: Database backups
corpus.content: Snapshots of production data are taken nightly and retained for ninety days in offsite storage. Restores are rehearsed quarterly.

corpus.title: Tomato soup recipe
corpus.content: Simmer ripe tomatoes with basil, garlic, and olive oil. Blend until smooth and season the soup with salt and pepper before serving.

corpus.title: Astronomy club notes
corpus.content: The club meets on clear evenings to point telescopes at nebulae and planets. New members learn to align the mount and pick eyepieces.
